title: Villager Workstations
blurb: Job site blocks used by unemployed villagers to acquire professions and replenish trades.
note: Tier C list rule. The 13 job site blocks are taken from the workstation ref each villager profession entity carries in data/dist/entities/profession-0.json. There are 13 workstations across 14 professions because the nitwit has no profession and no job site. The acquirable_job_site POI tag was not used because it resolves point-of-interest types rather than blocks, and the pipeline wires TagIndex only for the item and entity_type registries. Guarded by tests/test_collections_drift.py. Icon borrowed from Villager.
